reports.title: zkSync Era Security Audit: Bug Fixes Review Part 2
reports.description: ChainLight follow-up review of recently reported bugs and their fixes in the zkSync Era Boojum circuits, scoped to the diffs v0.150.20...protocol-v27-rc of zksync-protocol and v0.30.13...crypto-v27-rc of zksync-crypto (non-native field normalize/negated tracking, EVM simulator memory and gas stipends). No Critical/High issues were found; one Medium (BUGFIX2-005, in-circuit stipend not assigned to the callee frame) and one Low were patched.

reports.description: Taran Space audit (October-November 2025) of the callable_oracles and crypto crates of matter-labs/zksync-os at f32e78b, focusing on ECC and field arithmetic (secp256k1, secp256r1, BN254, BLS12-381, bigint delegation). Two Critical and one High finding were reported in the crypto crate and verified as fixed in December 2025 (fix commits not named).

versions.coverage: Full review of the crate at f32e78b; no Critical/High findings (only a QA note on missing tests/fuzzing).

Full review of the crypto crate (secp256k1/secp256r1, BN254 and BLS12-381 fields and pairings, bigint delegation) at f32e78b, with fuzzing.
